title: feat: add Span-01 Lite decision model via OpenRouter
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15852

- Adds `respan/span-01-lite`: no aliases, `/alpha/decisions` + `/v1/chat/completions`, `paidOnly: false`, zero cost, `priceMultiplier: 1`. No `contextLength`, since OpenRouter lists none (0).
- Routes it to `https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions` with the exact upstream ID through the existing `useSystemOneApi` adapter. Jev and the existing decision/chat surfaces are unchanged.
- The description says it accepts only `noul` questions with plain-string instructions and that Respan retains prompts (no training).
- Decision errors (bad message layout, bad JSON, missing config, upstream response without usage) now name the requested model instead of `typesafe/jev-1.13`.
- The free-tier exemption in the OpenRouter paid-only tests is now "supports `/alpha/decisions`" instead of a hardcoded Jev id.

## Verification

- Live requests to `https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions`:
  - `noul` question, plain-string instructions: 200, `noul: 0.964`, `usage: {input_tokens: 27, output_tokens: 0, cost: 0}`.
  - `choice` question and object-shaped `noul` instructions: both 400 `Respan only accepts noul questions whose instructions and criteria are plain strings`, which is what the description states.
- `systemOneClient.test.ts` (20 tests, run under a plain Node Vitest config) covers routing to the decisions endpoint with the Span ID and model-named errors. `tsc` is clean on the touched files.
- The Workers-pool tests (`decisions.test.ts`, `model-permissions.test.ts`, `pricing-data.test.ts`, price snapshot) can't run in my local environment, so CI is the check for those.

Not tested through the authenticated gateway (wallet debit / billed event).

gist.headline: A second opinion, in pixels
gist.blurb: Span-01 Lite joins the decision-model garden. Give it a `noul` question with plain-string instructions; it knows what to do with those, and politely rejects the other shapes.
gist.summary: Adds the free `respan/span-01-lite` model via OpenRouter to `/alpha/decisions` and `/v1/chat/completions`, routing decisions through the existing adapter and naming the requested model in decision errors.
gist.impact: Developers gain a zero-cost decision model for `noul` questions with plain-string instructions and criteria; Respan retains prompts but does not use them for training.
